# What Sonarr does at start with a config.xml from before Sonarr v3: the
# user and its password in <Username> and <Password>, in clear, and no
# user in the database (setup.sh makes the fixture so). A recording of
# its own; same format as ../golden/requests.txt.
#
#   GOLDEN_SETUP=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-legacy-user/setup.sh \
#       GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-legacy-user/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-legacy-user make golden
#
# The recorder logs in as unarr/fixture before the first request: the
# session requests below answer as they do only if that user exists,
# which only config.xml named. config-after.xml is the data directory's
# config.xml as Sonarr left it, copied by hand after the recording.
session-initialize GET /initialize.json
config-host GET /api/v3/config/host
noauth-initialize GET /initialize.json
